Best crypto inheritance tools (2026)

Casa and Unchained are the strongest choices for Bitcoin inheritance using multisig. Vault12 Guard suits people with many wallets who want social-recovery seed backup. Ledger Recover is a recovery service first and an inheritance tool second.

ToolBest for
CasaBitcoin holders who want self-custody plus a guided inheritance plan.
UnchainedLarger Bitcoin holdings, especially in the US, where a formal inheritance process is worth paying for.
Vault12 GuardSelf-custody users with many wallets who don't want a seed phrase stored in one place.
Ledger RecoverLedger owners worried about losing their seed phrase who accept ID verification.

1. Casa

Best for: Bitcoin holders who want self-custody plus a guided inheritance plan.

A leading multisig self-custody service with a dedicated inheritance feature for Bitcoin and other supported assets.

Pricing: Tiered memberships. Check current pricing.

2. Unchained

Best for: Larger Bitcoin holdings, especially in the US, where a formal inheritance process is worth paying for.

Collaborative-custody Bitcoin vaults (2-of-3 multisig) with inheritance planning. Strong for larger holdings.

Pricing: Check current pricing.

3. Vault12 Guard

Best for: Self-custody users with many wallets who don't want a seed phrase stored in one place.

Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals.

Pricing: Check current pricing.

4. Ledger Recover

Best for: Ledger owners worried about losing their seed phrase who accept ID verification.

An optional, ID-based seed backup for Ledger hardware wallets. Handy for recovery, but it's a trust trade-off and isn't primarily an inheritance tool.

Pricing: Paid subscription (Ledger has advertised $9.99/month). Check current pricing.
